title: NASA-Grade 33lb Digital Kitchen Scale, Precisely Measures Grams and Ounces for Baking and Cooking, Waterproof Tempered Glass
description:
About this item
【Accurate to 1g/0.1oz】This digital food scale provides you precise weight graduation accurate to 1g/0.1oz. Measuring range: 0.1oz to 33 lbs (3g to 15kg)
【5 Units Conversion】The Smart Unit Button of the small kitchen scale instantly converts between 5 units of measurements (g/kg/lb:oz/oz/ml). Automatic overload prompt and low voltage Indicator help to avoid damage
【Rechargeable&Auto off】This food scale rechargeable has two power methods: USB charging/battery powered. It can be switched on/off with just a press of the button and it would automatically turn off if there is no operation in 120s for energy-saving and eco-friendly
【Easy to Tare】You can get net food weight in a container with just a tap on the "TARE" button of the food scale waterproof, no need to do the calculation yourself
【Packing List】Package includes digital kitchen scale*1, USB cable*1, AAA batteries*2. We provide lifetime after-sales service and take full responsibility for loss or damage of the product during transportation and defects in materials and workmanship

reviews_5s:
This is a light weight kitchen scale that have a fairly large bright digital display. I do wish it would go to 2 digits on the ounces instead of one. So if you wish to weigh an item in lbs and ounces it will say 3.1 ounces for instants instead of a more precise 3.11 for most things this doesn't matter and it does weight in grams which is more precise than ounces anyway. The scale is nice and the footprint is small.Great Scale. Replacing old one. Ultra Light. Nice stainless steel top. Decent size to accommodate Med size Bowls.Great scale! It is accurate and easy to use. Love the quick response of the buttons.I initially bought this to weigh ingredients for my diy dog food recipes. Love it so much I use it for baking & other things in the house. Scale is accurate & easy to read. Works well. I do wish it was a couple inches bigger to fit larger size bowls. Fantastic that it’s rechargeable, holds charge through multiple uses. Will buy again if this one ever wears out, will probably opt for a larger one though.I love this little scale. It has excellent repeatability, It's just a simple, no-nonsense functioning scale. I have not checked the accuracy and calibration, but I would bet it's spot on. It does have impressive repeatability. And it's just the perfect size for my use, weighing components for a hobby. I'm happy with this purchase and would highly recommendThis scale has helped me immensely in my kitchen for baking cakes. It’s simple to use and is very accurate.The scale is easy to use. With the "tare" weight feature, you can subtract the weight of your container and measure just the material. I can't comment on the accuracy or durability because I just started using it. But it looks well made and accurate.I’ve had this scale for a year and still haven’t had to recharge the battery. I like the scratch resistant glass overlap and the ease of cleaning the surface. The display is easy to read and response time of scale to display the weight is practically instantaneousGrams or ounces .nice large platform. You can use batteries or the cord that comes with itMy only complaint about this product is that while the top is indeed waterproof, the battery compartment doesn't have so much as a rubber grommet on it and there are sort of "vents" around the feet that can both let water in and allow water to drip out. Don't plan on using this in a very wet evironment.

The best part of this scale is the built in rechargeable battery. Once it starts getting dim, I just plug it in overnight and it's back to 100%.
reviews_1s:
Crappy. Messed up a lot of batches because it gives inaccurate measurements. I’m not sure if it’s when the battery is low, but gives no indication it’s low- it just starts measuring wrongThese simply don’t work. They weighed up 3.5 lbs as 2 lbs. I went to check them with a 20 gram calibration weight and it measured it as 9 grams. Turned them off and back on to try again and it weighed them as 16 grams and slowly went up to 23 grams, then I tried taring the weight and removing it and the scales read -15, then it fluctuated a lot before I turned them off. Save your money and get a more reliable product.This unit did not work. No weight, no measurements, no anything! Returning after 3 minutes. BTW I did read the instructions and followed. I will look for another vendor.This is my second or third--and last--attempt to buy a digital kitchen scale. This one was never great. Often, upon being turned on, the display would show a frozen all-LEDs-showing reading that could only be cleared by removing and reinserting the batteries. The tare and unit buttons have reached a point where touching EITHER of them causes issues with the other (ie, tapping the tare button causes the unit to change from g to oz; tapping the unit button causes the display to go from 0 to some random value). Quite often, the measurement will continue to creep up long after you've stopped adding whatever it is you're trying to measure.

I sure hope someone still makes an old-school spring-activated scale, because these digital ones all bite.Seems like its well-constructed overall but it makes measuring things a huge hassle. The problem is the ENTIRE top surface, including the display and buttons contribute to the weight readout. So any time you press a button, say to change units or tare, you have to press it like 5 times because it's contending with the weight of your finger presses at the same time, it's SUPER ANNOYING. My other cheapo scale I'm trying to replace doesn't have this problem because the buttons and display are isolated from the weighing platform. I used it one time and because of these issues I need to return it.I have only owned the scale since August 2023. I use it almost exclusively to make pour over coffee.

Last week the weight would start going up without anything being added to the scale. I thought it was the battery and connected the USB power cable. That didn’t fix it.

Even working it has a design problem. The touch buttons are on the same piece of material as the scale. So when you press “tare” you are putting weight on the scale. Be careful.Used it maybe 10 times and it stopped measuring accurately. I tested it against a known weight and against 2 cups of purified water.Would not charge after the first charging. Seemed to work good plugged in for a few weeks. Then while using it in the middle of weighing it shut off (which really messed up my recipe). After it shut of in the midst of weighing the weights were definitely not right. I was initially very pleased with the way the unit worked.
The company sent me an email asking about my experience, and I told them the issues I am having. But I have not heard back from them about a replacement.This product is TRASH Don't buy it.scale stopped working after less than 4 months of use- not made well, do not order
